thread:
jamie: Scheduled APAC NIC firmware maintenance for apac-west1 gpu-pool tonight 23:30-00:30 UTC. Reason: reduce rare packet drops observed at NIC driver v2.4. Plan: staggered rack reboots, egress path validation, KV cache re-seed, and temporary capacity hedge from us-east1.

rachel: What's the expected customer impact? Any dedicated tenants in that pool?

jamie: No dedicated tenants in affected racks. Only shared/interruptible workload. Estimated capacity loss: ~18 GPUs for ~45m during rolling reboots per cohort. We'll preserve two racks for emergency spillover.

tom: Can we pre-warm cross-region egress? Network egress is constrained tonight between APAC and US due to provider maintenance. If we push too much to us-east1 it may saturate the peering. Suggest local backfill from apac-standby first, then us-east secondary.

jamie: Good call. Revised order: apac-standby -> apac-edge-standby -> us-east failover. Also will throttle cross-region shift rate to 10%/minute.

evan: Ops checklist:
```
1) cordon: ./clusterctl cordon --pool apac-west1 --racks r2-r5
2) drain: ./ops/drain --grace 400 --strategy graceful
3) kv-seed: ./ops/kv-seed --pool apac-west1 --racks r2-r5 --parallel 1
4) net-check: ./netcheck --to us-east1 --timeout 120
```

rachel: Cost FYI: apac-standby backfill adds ~9 GPU-hours (~$1.6k). Cross-region egress estimated additional $450 if used. Flagged to finance.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance tonight 23:30 UTC 1:00 prior-warning & 5m/1m before starting. Pager thresholds: P95 latency > 220ms for 5m OR sustained packet drops > 0.2% for 10m.

tom: Also: bump kv-cache timeouts to 900s pre-maint to lower cold-starts. Patch config: `redis.timeout=900`.

jamie: Will do. If we detect packet drop spike on r2 canary within 10m we'll pause and rollback r2, then escalate to networking. Rollback criteria: packet drops >0.5% OR task eviction >1%.

finance-bot: Logged estimated incremental cost: $2.05k (labels: apac-maint, cross-region-egress). Approvers: finance-team notified.

ops-runbook-bot: Log created id=mn-9490001111 by jamie (apac-west1 racks r2-r10, canary r2, standby backfill apac-standby).
